description:
## Background

After the Issue Explorer runtime is behind its public coordinator interface, its internal presentation still has several independently updated React states: Issue state, Workspace state, Workspace identity marker, refresh health, and dismissed switch-error generation. The transition gate also carries refresh health. Multiple publication paths previously allowed the gate and React presentation to drift.

The final cleanup should reduce those synchronization paths without weakening the coordinator seam or creating shallow private hooks. It should also leave `App` as a renderer shell and remove routing composition that no longer changes what renders.

Triage: `ready-for-agent`.

## What to build

Consolidate accepted Issue Explorer presentation changes through one internal update path, centralize no-Workspace presentation, and finish reducing `App` to shell composition. Remove the redundant Issue Explorer route switch while preserving the Settings overlay and every marker/navigation behavior.

## Technical Approach

- Keep the synchronous transition-gate ref as the admission authority where needed by concurrent callbacks.
- Publish admitted Issue state, Workspace state, Workspace identity marker, and `next.refreshHealth` through one internal presentation update operation instead of unrelated setter interpretations.
- Include dismissed switch-error generation in the same presentation model when that reduces synchronization complexity without coupling unrelated settings or sidebar state.
- Centralize duplicated no-Workspace presentation logic while preserving the `"/__initial__"`, `"/__removed__"`, and `"/__reset__"` marker values and their different meanings.
- Keep Pending Workspace masking behavior: retain the successful Issue snapshot for cancellation while presenting loading.
- Confirm no Issue Explorer descendant consumes Wouter route-param context, then replace the Issue Explorer `<Switch>` whose branches all render the same element with direct rendering. Keep the Settings `<Switch>`.
- Do not split presentation and lifecycle into private hooks if their proposed interface would expose gate refs, deferred buffers, multiple setters, or pass-through callbacks.

## Considerations

- Current Workspace and its matching Issue Explorer snapshot must publish atomically.
- An in-place refresh must not change Workspace identity marker, Issue List View, Issue Search, or selected Issue.
- Refresh health must come from the gate's admitted next state so identity changes cannot retain stale health.
- Removing Current Workspace must still show the chooser and advance the data marker without introducing a React remount.
- Reset memory must retain its established `"/__reset__"` presentation.
- Settings must continue hiding, rather than unmounting, the underlying Issue Explorer presentation.
- This issue must not change routes, user-facing copy, or visual layout.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Accepted Issue/Workspace/marker/health presentation changes flow through one internal publication path.
- [ ] No-Workspace presentation logic is centralized without collapsing marker meanings.
- [ ] Pending masking and cancellation retention behave as before.
- [ ] `data-workspace-key` remains stable across in-place refreshes and no React `key` is added.
- [ ] `App` retains only route matching/canonicalization, settings, sidebar state, Settings navigation, and JSX composition.
- [ ] The redundant Issue Explorer `<Switch>` is removed after confirming route-param context is unused.
- [ ] No shallow private lifecycle/presentation seam is introduced merely to reduce file length.
- [ ] `mise run doctor:react` and `mise run verify` pass.

## Test Plan

- Preserve App-level Workspace switching, cancellation, removal, reset-memory, refresh, Settings, and marker-stability coverage.
- Add focused assertions only where the consolidated publication path exposes an uncovered regression risk; do not duplicate transition-gate truth tables.
- Run `mise run ts:typecheck` and focused TypeScript tests while iterating.
- Run `mise run doctor:react` and `mise run verify` before completion.
- No new desktop E2E scenario is required because user-visible paths remain unchanged.
title: Consolidate Issue Explorer presentation publication
